newsitem.title: BRAZIL: ASEAN secretary-general to visit Brazil.
newsitem.headline: ASEAN secretary-general to visit Brazil.

text.p: The secretary-general of the Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN) arrives in Brazil on Tuesday at the start of a three-day visit to discuss ties, the Brazilian Foreign Ministry said on Monday.

The ministry said in a statement that Ajit Singh, a former Malaysian ambassador to Brazil, would hold talks with President Fernando Henrique Cardoso and Foreign Minister Luiz Felipe Lampreia in Brasilia on Wednesday.
The main subject under discussion will be links between the Asian group and the Mercosur trade bloc, comprised of Brazil, Argentina, Uruguay and Paraguay.
ASEAN is made up of Singapore, the Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam and Brunei. Cambodia, Burma and Laos are expected to join later this year.
ASEAN secretary-general Singh heads to Sao Paulo on Thursday and leaves Brazil on Friday, the Foreign Ministry said.
